summary: Iteration 3 — ALL 16 new backend pytest cases + full frontend E2E on Expo web (mobile 390x844) PASS. Backend: (a) OTP verify with '+250798875272' AND '250798875272' both return user.role='admin' (auto-promotion from ADMIN_PHONES env strips '+') and a fresh non-admin phone returns non-admin role. (b) GET /api/programs returns exactly 3 items ordered BBSPORTSTALK, B&B SPORTS BAR, #IMPUMEKOYIWACU (note: field is 'name', not 'title'). (c) GET /api/settings returns stationName='B&B Kigali', frequency='89.7 FM', stationTagline='#MuriSiporonIgitego' (frontend also reads stationTagline). (d) GET /api/shows contains a show with videoUrl including 'Jsi8atSWGbg'. (e) Admin PUT /api/admin/settings {youtubeLiveUrl:...v=Jsi8atSWGbg} → immediately after, GET /api/radio/now-playing returns youtubeVideoId='Jsi8atSWGbg' (then restored). (f) Non-admin PUT /api/admin/settings returns 403; unauth returns 401. (g) Admin POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/programs CRUD works (create needs 'name' field). (h) Admin POST /api/admin/shows creates a show. (i) Non-premium GET /api/shows/{id} on premium show returns locked=true, unlockPrice='1.00', unlockCurrency='EUR'. (j) POST /api/billing/vod/{id}/create returns orderId + approveUrl containing 'paypal.com'. (k) MoMo /initiate with 250794230137 writes db.payments.besoftPayload.debit.metadata.kind='debit_credit' and credits[0].payee_identifier='250798875272' — VERIFIED in Mongo. Frontend: signed in as admin +250798875272 → home shows 'B&B KIGALI 89.7 FM' + '#MuriSiporonIgitego', 3 program cards (program-<id>) with 'MOST POPULAR' badge on first, home-live-news + home-shows visible, home-admin visible; tapping opens /admin (admin-home) with all 3 admin-card-* buttons. admin-card-settings screen shows input-station-name, input-radio-url, input-youtube-live, settings-save. admin-card-programs shows admin-programs list + programs-add opens new form with prog-name input. admin-card-shows opens admin-shows. home-live-news → live-news screen with a YouTube iframe (src=https://www.youtube.com/embed/wPD77ygQKfo?...). Signed in as +250788111133 → NO home-admin, tapping first premium show shows locked-box with buy-vod-btn 'PAY 1.00 EUR' and go-premium-btn 'OR GO PREMIUM'.
